title: Test vectors: relay signer identity + multi-hop chain
description: Author/extend canonical vectors in test/vectors/ for the selected option. PENDING project-LICHEN-worker6-nxew. Baseline already present: wire_format_v2.json (SI+S normal/relay-resigned/malformed, hop re-signing inputs). Add: 3-node A->B->C relay chain where C's trust cache pins B (immediate signer) while payload origin is A (preserved DAO origin) and a variant with RFC 6554 SRH destination mutation; key-substitution attempt (attacker reuses victim SIID with own key) must fail closed; pinned-SIID key-mismatch (TOFU violation) must fail closed; cache-behavior vectors per decided semantics. If option (a)/(c): regenerate all signed-frame corpora (link_frame.json, link_frame_signed_modes.json, wire_format_v2.json, link-edge-fuzz.json, frame_length_boundaries.json). Acceptance: vectors generated by independent oracle (reference_schnorr48.py / OpenSSL path), committed JSON consumed by C/Rust/Python tests, all three impls agree.
